title: Modular Monolith Architecture Rules
description: Rules governing the mandatory starting topology for all Evolith satellites. Modular Monolith is the only permitted entry point unless extraction criteria are already satisfied.

rules.title: Single Deployment Unit
rules.description: All bounded contexts MUST be deployed as a single artifact (monolith). No autonomous deployment of individual modules is permitted.
rules.rationale: core/ADR-0047 mandates modular monolith as the canonical starting topology. Premature extraction introduces operational complexity without proven scalability drivers.
rules.validationQuery: Verify all modules compile into a single assembly/container image. No independent module deployment pipelines.

rules.title: Explicit Bounded Context Boundaries
rules.description: Each bounded context MUST be implemented as a clearly separated module with its own namespace/package and zero runtimeshared database.
rules.rationale: core/ADR-0031 (Schema-per-Context) requires each bounded context to own its schema. Runtime shared databases create implicit coupling.
rules.validationQuery: Each bounded context has isolated persistence (separate DB/schema). No cross-context direct table access.

rules.title: Ports and Adapters Boundary
rules.description: All bounded contexts MUST implement hexagonal architecture (core/ADR-0002). Domain layer has zero external dependencies. Infrastructure adapters are injected via ports.
rules.rationale: Hexagonal architecture enables future extraction by decoupling domain logic from infrastructure concerns.
rules.validationQuery: Domain layer has no imports from Infrastructure. Adapters implement port interfaces defined in Application layer.

rules.title: Inter-Context Communication via Ports
rules.description: Cross-bounded-context communication MUST use explicit application-layer port interfaces. No direct infrastructure-to-infrastructure calls.
rules.rationale: Enforces clean dependency direction. Changes in one context do not directly break another context.
rules.validationQuery: No cross-context imports at the Infrastructure layer. All inter-context calls go through Application ports.

rules.title: No Shared Database Across Bounded Contexts
rules.description: Each bounded context MUST have its own database schema or database instance. Shared database is prohibited.
rules.rationale: core/ADR-0031 enforces schema-per-context ownership. Shared database prevents independent evolution of contexts.
rules.validationQuery: Each bounded context maps to a separate schema (PostgreSQL schema separation) or separate database instance.

rules.title: Async Events Use Domain Events
rules.description: When bounded contexts emit events for async reaction, they MUST use domain events with explicit event contracts (core/ADR-0015). No implicit table-polling or direct queue manipulation.
rules.rationale: Domain events enforce explicit contract boundaries and make cross-context reactions auditable.
rules.validationQuery: Event-driven reactions subscribe to domain event types, not database change streams.

rules.title: Maintain Extraction Readiness Score
rules.description: Satellite MUST track and maintain extraction readiness score per core/ADR-0045. Score MUST be >= 70% to pass Phase 2 Design gate when F2 is planned.
rules.rationale: core/ADR-0045 defines concrete readiness criteria. Measuring continuously prevents technical debt accumulation.
rules.validationQuery: Extraction readiness assessment documented and updated at each phase transition. Score >= 70% for F2 transition.

rules.title: Observability Instrumentation
rules.description: All bounded contexts MUST emit OTel traces with CorrelationId, TraceId, and SpanId per nodejs/ADR-0007. Logs MUST include structured SessionTrackingId.
rules.rationale: Production readiness requires observability from day one. dotnet/ADR-0064 defines .NET context propagation; nodejs/ADR-0007 covers Node.js.
rules.validationQuery: All API endpoints produce traces with bounded context tag. Logs include SessionTrackingId scope.

rules.title: Strict Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP)
rules.description: Application and Domain services MUST NOT be instantiated manually via 'new' keywords within other services or controllers. Dependencies MUST be injected via constructor using a DI container.
rules.rationale: Manual instantiation tightly couples classes to specific implementations, violating DIP and preventing effective unit testing and future architectural decoupling.
rules.validationQuery: Verify AST for 'new' expressions instantiating domain/application services within other services/controllers. Expected 0 occurrences.

rules.title: AST-Based Code Analysis Mandatory
rules.description: Static code analysis, architecture compliance checks, and automated refactoring MUST use Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing. Regular Expressions (Regex) for structural code parsing are prohibited.
rules.rationale: Regex is fragile for code parsing and cannot reliably understand context, nesting, or syntax variations. AST provides accurate structural representation.
rules.validationQuery: Scan architecture validation scripts for structural regex patterns targeting source code instead of AST parser usage.

rules.title: Strict UI and Logic Isolation (SoC)
rules.description: Interactive UI logic (e.g., CLI prompts, HTTP request extraction) MUST NOT leak into Application Use Cases or Domain logic. The Ports & Adapters boundary MUST be respected.
rules.rationale: Leaking UI concerns into application logic prevents reusing the same logic across different interfaces (e.g., CLI vs MCP vs HTTP) and makes automated testing difficult.
rules.validationQuery: Verify Application/Domain layers have zero imports from UI/CLI libraries (e.g., '@clack/prompts', 'inquirer', 'express').

rules.title: Pure Domain Model (Data Mapper Enforcement)
rules.description: Domain entities SHOULD NOT reference persistence frameworks. Use Data Mapper pattern to keep domain model pure and persistence-agnostic.
rules.rationale: Persistence annotations in domain entities create coupling to infrastructure and violate hexagonal architecture (core/ADR-0002). Data Mapper preserves domain purity.
rules.validationQuery: AST scan for persistence-related annotations (e.g., @Entity, @Table, [Column]) in domain-layer files. Expected 0 occurrences.

exitGate.description: Modular Monolith exits when extraction readiness score >= 70% AND architecture board approves F2 transition.
